name: Tempester 1.6.7.0 — Release up to 127 with Tempester Voice
summary: Everything in 1.6.6.0; the five Release parameters go up to 127 again once the six voice chips run Tempester Voice 1.5.1.0, and the machine reports the Voice OS version of each chip.

fixes: Pitch, Filter, Amp, Aux 1 and Aux 2 Release reach 127 when all six voice chips run Tempester Voice 1.5.1.0, whose releases always end (up to 60 s). With any chip on DSI's Voice OS they stay capped at 123, as in 1.6.6.0.
additions: The version request also reports the Voice OS version of each of the six voice chips.

description: 1.6.6.0 plus n°63 in its 1.6.7.0 form (the cap only while a chip did not answer 0x16 at start-up) and n°64 (message 45 after the 43 reply), proved on the test build 1.6.7.0-a and on this image. n°9a and n°39 come from their 1.6.7.0 copies patch/nrpn_reception_1670.json and patch/version_request_1670.json (one word of each is n°63's / n°64's). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged. Installed on 14/11/2026 with Tempester Voice 1.5.1.0 on the six chips: message 45 reports six 0x16, the Release knobs reach 127 (checked by ear by the author). Its full backup reads past a Voice chip's flash on a second request in the same power-on: fixed in 1.6.8.0.
